discussion.key_messages: - A cool and stable airmass will settle across the region through the weekend. - A weak weather system will bring a chance of snow showers mainly to northern Utah Monday, with little if any accumulation. - Another weak system is forecast to cross the region on Thanksgiving. This will bring a small chance for valley rain and mountain snow to northern Utah, while southern Utah remains largely dry.
